It announces an invitation for media to hear from NASA astronauts Butch Wilmore and Suni Williams during a call discussing the NASA Boeing Space Crew Flight Test mission. The call is scheduled for 11 am ET on July 10. The tweet includes a link to more information: "go.nasa.gov/3xxiRwl."
